preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 10**5 and 1 <= k <= 10**5 for n, k in [(int(x) for x in stdin.split()[0:2])])
preconditions.description: n and k are integers within the bounds 1 ≤ n, k ≤ 10^5.
The input contains exactly n non-empty strings, one per line.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c.islower() for c in s) for s in [stdin.splitlines()[1:]])
preconditions.description: Each string consists only of lowercase English letters.
The total length of all strings does not exceed 10^5.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().split() == [str(count_pairs(a, k, i)) for i in range(n)]
postconditions.description: For each string a[i] (1 ≤ i ≤ n), the output is the count of valid (l, r) pairs such that the substring a[i][l..r] appears in at least k strings in the array a (including a[i]).

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(x) <= len(a[i]) * (len(a[i]) + 1) // 2 for i, x in enumerate(stdout.strip().split()))
postconditions.description: Each output integer is a non-negative count of valid (l, r) pairs for the corresponding string, bounded by the maximum possible pairs in that string.
